catalog.description: Compare two caller-supplied vendor pricing-row JSON objects (rows of field, finite numeric value, and unit) and return field, unit, added, and removed budget-impact deltas. HTTP JSON only: no filesystem paths, commands, URLs, or writable caches. Identical rows are informational, not failure. Charge is the bounded compare, not a live quote, purchase, or ROI. Ordinary wallets sign through examples/customer-x402, not a precomputed signature. Initial live release accepts x402 only.
